summary: New Era Energy & Digital, Inc. filed a Rule 424(b)(5) prospectus supplement for an at-the-market equity program of up to $100 million of common stock, sold through Mizuho, B. Riley, Northland, Texas Capital Securities, BTIG and Roth Capital as sales agents under a September 24, 2026 sales agreement. Shares trade on Nasdaq as NUAI, last sale $6.99 on September 23, 2026; agent compensation is up to 3.5% of gross proceeds, with no escrow and no obligation to sell. This is an ordinary shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch dilution, selling pace and any use-of-proceeds disclosure.
